C0828.title: AI Voice Cloning Emerges as New BEC Attack Vector: Deepfake CEO Scams
C0828.summary: According to Keepnet Labs data, deepfake-related fraud losses in the United States reached $1.1 billion in 2025, tripling from $360 million the previous year. Attackers use AI voice cloning technology to replicate executive voices with just three seconds of audio, impersonating CEOs over the phone to defraud employees. Such attacks surged 1740% in North America.
